anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used to format the dataset, not a paper describing this propofol dreaming EEG dataset.

anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: EEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard/specification used to format this dataset, not a paper describing this propofol sedation dreaming EEG dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded in BrainVision format during wakefulness (eyes closed, eyes open, and TMS sessions) and during propofol sedation. Sedation sessions included repeated awakenings (runs 1-3), each preceded by a one-minute resting EEG segment.
